mechanism: Both drugs cause potassium depletion and hyperglycemia; triamcinolone enhances the hypokalemic and hyperglycemic effects of chlorthalidone while increasing fluid retention that counteracts diuretic efficacy.
action: Monitor serum potassium and glucose levels closely; consider potassium supplementation or concurrent potassium-sparing agent; assess blood pressure control and adjust chlorthalidone dose if needed.
